ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)

Best ENT hospital in Ranchi with advanced treatments for ear, nose, throat, and voice disorders

Overview

The ENT Department at Raj Hospitals, Ranchi, is recognized as one of the best in Jharkhand for comprehensive ear, nose, and throat treatments. With advanced diagnostic tools, modern surgical equipment, and highly skilled ENT specialists, we provide world-class care for patients suffering from ear infections, sinus problems, throat disorders, hearing loss, allergies, and balance issues. Our facilities include advanced audiology, speech therapy, and minimally invasive surgical procedures.

Why Choose Our ENT Department

  • Round-the-clock emergency ENT care
  • Voice disorder and phonosurgery unit
  • Vertigo clinic and vestibular rehab program
  • Advanced diagnostic audiology services
  • State-of-the-art operating theatres

Treatments We Offer

Comprehensive ENT care with advanced techniques

Rhinology & Sinus Care

Advanced diagnosis and minimally invasive procedures for sinusitis, nasal polyps, and rhinology-related conditions.

Sleep Apnea & Snoring Disorders

Specialized diagnosis and treatment for obstructive sleep apnea and snoring-related ENT conditions.

Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery (FESS)

Minimally invasive sinus surgery for chronic sinusitis and nasal blockages.

Audiology & Hearing Aids

Hearing assessments, audiometry, and advanced hearing aids for hearing loss.

Speech Therapy & Voice Disorders

Phonosurgery, voice rehabilitation, and speech therapy programs.

Pediatric ENT Care

Dedicated treatments for children including tonsillitis, adenoidectomy, and ear infections.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about ENT conditions and treatments

What are common symptoms of ENT problems?

Ear pain, hearing loss, chronic sinusitis, allergies, sore throat, snoring, and persistent headaches are indicators of ENT issues.

Do you treat sleep apnea?

Yes, we provide comprehensive care for obstructive sleep apnea including diagnostics, medical therapies, and surgical interventions.

Is surgery always needed for sinus problems?

Not always. Initial treatments include medicines, sprays, and lifestyle changes. Surgery like FESS is only recommended for chronic cases.

Can hearing loss be treated?

Yes, we provide audiology assessments, hearing aids, and surgical options for conditions like otosclerosis or acoustic neuroma.
